bundle.shortDescription: Turn PDF pages into Markdown with halogen-flash-server
bundle.longDescription: DocProc4 Halogen renders PDF pages and transcribes them into Markdown using halogen-flash-server (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on AMD Strix Halo), with KV-pool caching, session handles, MTP speculation telemetry, and vision-tower budget tuning.
